result.title: Queryable Gaussian View Index: Text Retrieval and Selective Camera Localization
result.summary: We present Queryable Gaussian View Index (QGVI) for querying existing Gaussian scene assets and their associated calibrated reference data. Text-view retrieval and selective RGB camera localization return poses in the asset's coordinate frame. QGVI-T turns Gaussian-rendered views into a language-searchable index of scene locations, binding structured captions to known camera poses and place identifiers. Semantic and lexical retrieval select views from distinct places without online rendering, VLM calls, or a scene-specific pose network. The image route, QGVI-I, filters LoGS-based geometric estimates using distinct inlier query keypoints. It omits photometric refinement and preserves accepted pose coordinates. On nine development scenes, QGVI-T achieves 58.3% Top-1 and 78.3% Top-5 joint relevance-and-validity success, compared with 26.1% and 34.6% for our CityLoC reimplementation with refinement. QGVI-I achieves 97.3% scene-mean pose success at 1 m/2 degrees, with pooled false-acceptance and false-rejection rates of 0.707% and 1.142%. A paired cached evaluation retains all 1,775 initializer poses correct at this threshold. Recorded median text query latency is 0.020 s. Matched controls show competitive BM25 retrieval and slightly lower false acceptance for thresholded full LoGS; grid augmentation suggests modest gains on novel-view-derived descriptions. We report model-judged semantic success separately from source-camera recovery, with source-verified or estimated scales for geometric evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 QGVI，在已有 Gaussian 场景资产上构建可文本检索的视图索引，把结构化描述绑定到已知相机位姿与地点标识，并用关键点内点筛选实现选择性 RGB 相机定位，在九个场景上报告检索与位姿成功率及延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 预先构建的视图—描述索引支持离线语义检索，配合内点门控的候选接受机制，可能为 LVR 中「该取哪份视觉证据」及证据验证与接受决策提供线索，但其目标是位姿估计而非推理，需核查。
